Default startup therefore provides a source-supported conditional route to the proof modules. No actual traversal of that route was observed.

substantiveAssessment.assessment: Read complete explicit name/file/descriptor/version selection, refresh, mount, localization and unload routes and applicable public/private declarations. Both the public MountExplicitlyLoadedPlugin declaration and private MountPluginFromExternalSource declaration default MaxLoadingPhase to ELoadingPhase::Max. Omitted caller arguments were joined to these declarations, not inferred from implementation signatures. The implementation iterates phases from zero while phase is less than MaxLoadingPhase and skips None.
concreteRelationships: Explicit mount marks enabled, registers applicable content/binary paths, attempts module phases and marks mounted. It ignores TryLoadModulesForPlugin's Boolean result inside the phase loop. A true explicit-mount result or mounted/enabled flag does not establish successful module loading.

Missing plugins, explicit-loading requirements and conflicting mounted versions have separate failure routes. Unload uses reverse phase checks and failure handling; it was not conflated with mount success.

Caller gates include editor/user operations, successful download or package completion, DLC flags/pak availability, feature URL/path/policy/filter/state and asynchronous completion conditions, commandlet settings, and test compilation. Their presence does not establish actual activation.

errorsAndRecoveries: Several combined policy/coverage, normative, catalog, selector-distribution, binding and module-analysis displays were truncated. Required source sections were reread with positive physical ranges. Material data was recovered through complete presence-aware state queries, complete identity comparisons, complete graph traversals and complete exception queries; no row sampling or arbitrary input cap supplied coverage.
An initial header-search pattern returned no match. The wrapper's actual PATH/RANGE header form was then queried successfully. No missing source unit was inferred from that search result.
A query appended an absent optional grant-category property and failed on ContainsKey(null). It was rerun with category-presence tests. The failure was not reported as source null data.

An independently authored conditional traversal initially used ContainsKey on an OrderedDictionary root object. It failed before a result and was corrected to a compatible derived root object; all six complete graph scenarios then completed.
One long analysis command exited without output, and one longer read's output was not collected. Their dependent results were recovered with shorter self-contained reads and queries.

An initial whole-JSON membership equality check was too coarse. Property-level ordered comparison established zero path or byte-count differences, 245 hash-string casing differences and zero SHA256 digest differences. Earlier wording claiming exact membership identity was corrected.

An authored-to-staged query initially treated six expected non-staged artifacts as comparison failures. The staging relationship was reread and reported accurately as twelve authored staged paths within thirty-three staged source members.
Prompt/GO files were not assumed to be ordinary inputFiles members. Their prospective bindings were verified through their dedicated descriptors instead.

Earlier outputs remain part of the record. Recovery does not erase exposure or enlarge grants. No unselected source value or synthesized missing-member null was adopted as evidence. No unresolved EOF, JSON parse or mandatory-range completeness error remains.
